SPI Breakdown — where the number comes from

SNoWBSGrandParentName/BOQItemNameUOMQtyQty Planned in This PeriodStart DateEnd DateDurationWORK DONE%age of Work DoneSPIStatus

This sheet is filled by ⬆ Import Plan (not typed here). Use ⬇ Export Plan to get the template, fill Planned Qty / Start Date / Duration in Excel, then Import back. End, % (vs Planned Qty) & Status come from your daily progress. SPI per item = Earned Qty ÷ Planned-Qty-to-date; the group/overall SPI is weighted by planned value (correct across mixed units like m³, tons, m²). Press 💾 SAVE to store.

Data Backup

All data is saved automatically in this browser on this computer. Export a backup regularly (e.g. weekly) to keep your records safe or to move them to another computer. To restore a backup, use the ⬆ Import Data button at the top (your password required).

Sharing with another person? Use 📤 Save shareable App — it creates an HTML file with all current users, BOQ and records built in, so when they open it nothing is missing. (A plain copy of this file opens empty on their computer, because data lives in the browser, not in the file.)
